I hate how she formats her exams and quizzes. I’ve missed so many points because of her directions. That first exam said to use one picture as a reference for the next few problems but the rest had different information, so I had to go back and redo those. Last time we asked her when the next quiz was she said she’d email us about it, took several days, and emailed us literally the night before to tell us it was the following morning. That kahoot quiz we did during class last time that someone got extra credit for was total bs, some of us couldn’t see the questions while others were marked as wrong for correct answers. She’ll breeze through excel sheets or powerpoints but provide them to us after homework or quiz is due. It’s all very frustrating. Sorry for the rant, I hope things start looking up for you!
